task_completion.description: Disable 'Anyone can register' in WordPress General Settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In Settings > General, the 'Membership' checkbox for 'Anyone can register' is unchecked.
In Settings > General, the 'New User Default Role' dropdown shows 'Subscriber' as the selected value.

task_completion.description: Bulk delete all users with the 'Contributor' role.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Users list, the 'Contributor' role filter should show 0 users, or the agent is seen selecting all users with the 'Contributor' role and applying the 'Delete' bulk action.

task_completion.description: Delete the user 'spam_master' and all their associated content.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The user 'spam_master' is no longer in the Users list. During deletion, the agent must select 'Delete all content' rather than 'Attribute all content to...' in the confirmation screen.

task_completion.description: Bulk delete all tags that have 0 posts associated with them.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In Posts > Tags, the list shows only tags with a 'Count' of 1 or more. The agent is seen selecting tags where the 'Count' column is '0' and applying the 'Delete' bulk action.

integrity.description: The agent used the WordPress dashboard GUI to perform actions.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with WordPress menus, checkboxes, and buttons rather than just executing WP-CLI commands in a terminal.

integrity.description: Legitimate users (Administrator, Author) and tags with posts were preserved.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Users list still contains the admin account, and the Tags list still contains tags with a count > 0.

integrity.description: The agent specifically confirmed the deletion of content for spam_master.
integrity.visual_evidence: A screenshot shows the WordPress confirmation page for deleting a user with the 'Delete all content' radio button selected.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The environment starts with 12 'Contributor' users, a user named 'spam_master' who has 3 posts, and 15 tags that have a post count of 0. To be successful, the 'Anyone can register' box must be unchecked, default role must be 'subscriber', the contributor count must reach 0, 'spam_master' must be gone with their 3 posts deleted, and all 15 empty tags must be removed.
